title: Is Islam the anti-Christ today?
segments: Islam is the Antichrist of the end
times, sort of. Mainstream evangelical
Christians have taught for decades that
the Antichrist will arise from the
Islamic world, often identifying him as
the Mahdi and using the conflict between
Isaac and Ishmael in Galatians 4 to
perpetuate the narrative. Now, Islam is
obviously a false religion that denies
the biblical Christ, but that doesn't
mean that the final Antichrist will be a
Muslim. In fact, Islam may actually play
a completely different role in the end
times than what Christians have been
taught. Let me explain. Jesus warned
that false Christs would attempt to
deceive the very elect, meaning that the
Antichrist will prioritize deceiving
believers, possibly by masking himself
as the defender of the people whom
Christians have been taught to believe
are the chosen people of God, defeating
what they've been conditioned to think
is the ultimate enemy, which according
to pulpits and Fox News is Islam. In
other words, Islam may actually be the
scapegoat of the end times, the apparent
enemy he defeats in order to present
himself as the Messiah. But how does he
do this? Well, Revelation 6:1 tells us
that the Antichrist will go forth
conquering and to conquer, meaning that
he will be involved in world wars,
potentially against countries that have
been labeled as hostile regimes that are
not controlled by usury-based banking,
posing a threat to the one world
currency that he's planning to institute
through the mark of the beast, thereby
creating the perfect pretext for war.
You see, Islam will actually be the
visible enemy used to divert attention
from the real Antichrist that is
operating behind the scenes. So, while
Christians are fixated on the decoy,
true enemy could be presenting himself
as the hero plotting their destruction.
